notes_for_editor: The only lookout facts come from a terse firelookout.com entry ('1938: L-4 cab. Emergency 1960s. Gone.'). The 1938 date is read as the build date and no second source confirms it; 'Emergency 1960s' is unexplained and left out of events. Two searches and the Wild Montana trail page mention no lookout structure. Trail length and gain conflict on the same Wild Montana page (1.5 miles vs 5 miles roundtrip; 500 ft vs 2,100 ft gain), so the story gives no figures.
